description.en: Google Gemini API (AI Studio) with native generateContent transform for OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, and Responses, plus the native gemini arm that forwards the gateway's pre-folded generateContent bodies (chat-surface image generation included).
description.zh: Google Gemini API（AI Studio）：在插件内把 OpenAI Chat / Anthropic Messages / Responses 转成 generateContent，并提供原生 gemini 臂，透传网关折好的 generateContent 体（含 chat 面生图）。

description.en: Paste a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Models are discovered from your account.
description.zh: 粘贴 Google AI Studio 的 Gemini API Key；模型将从你的账号自动发现。
